## Context
Discovered while landing abasic-doddering-harrier. Annotating `repo_root` parameters caused formatter-required wrapping and moved `src/rebar/attest/authorship.py` from 784 to 793 LOC against the hard 800 cap in `.github/module-size-limit.txt`. The prior change is correct and merged; this task buys back module-size headroom through a behavior-preserving split.

Re-wrapping is not an alternative because `ruff format --check` enforces the current layout. Raising the cap is prohibited by project policy.

## Plan
- Create `src/rebar/attest/authorship_resolution.py` for the existing git-ancestry/commit-resolution cluster: `resolve_event_commit`, `resolve_position_commit`, `build_ticket_position_commit_map`, `build_introducing_commit_map`, and `build_position_commit_map`. This is an existing call-graph seam of roughly 330 LOC, so the new module is above the 100-LOC floor while `authorship.py` returns to the 200-500 target band.
- Import and re-export all five names from `authorship.py`, preserving the current `rebar.attest.authorship.<name>` paths used by production callers and tests.
- Preserve the established subprocess monkeypatch seam explicitly: git subprocess calls in the moved implementation resolve the runner through the live `authorship.subprocess` compatibility attribute at call time, so `monkeypatch.setattr(authorship, "subprocess", ...)` still intercepts them. This is compatibility indirection only; git arguments, branches, timeouts, fallbacks, return values, and exception handling remain unchanged.
- Preserve the internal spy path explicitly: `verify_authorship_at_commit._resolve` remains in `authorship.py` and continues its module-global lookup of `resolve_event_commit`. The module-level imported binding is the re-export, and replacing `authorship.resolve_event_commit` updates that same module dictionary entry, so existing counting spies remain observable.
- Validate the complete string-reference population for all five names. Known consumers include `opcert.py`, `verify_authorship.py`, `verify_opcert.py`, `compact_txn.py`, and `compact.py`; monkeypatch consumers include `test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py`, `test_authorship_resolver_git_flags.py`, `test_authorship_resolver_git_flags_heldout.py`, `test_identity_perf_1cc0.py`, `test_identity_ts2_09f9_heldout.py`, `test_verify_identity_a2c7_perf.py`, `test_identity_gate_scope_and_ledger.py`, `test_compact_sweep_perf.py`, and the integration bulk-parity test. Because Serena is unavailable in this Codex session, confirm every receiver/name-string site with repository-wide `rg` before implementation handoff.
- Move code without changing decision logic. The only edited lookup is the compatibility indirection required to preserve the existing subprocess test seam.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `test "$(wc -l < src/rebar/attest/authorship.py)" -le 500` exits 0.
- [ ] `test "$(wc -l < src/rebar/attest/authorship_resolution.py)" -ge 100` exits 0.
- [ ] `python -c "from rebar.attest import authorship; [getattr(authorship, n) for n in (\"resolve_event_commit\", \"resolve_position_commit\", \"build_ticket_position_commit_map\", \"build_introducing_commit_map\", \"build_position_commit_map\")]"` exits 0.
- [ ] `pytest -q tests/unit/test_authorship_resolver_git_flags.py tests/unit/test_authorship_resolver_git_flags_heldout.py tests/integration/test_authorship_resolver_bulk_parity.py` passes, proving the `authorship.subprocess` monkeypatch still intercepts every moved resolver path.
- [ ] `pytest -q tests/unit/test_authorship_batched_ticket_map_7084.py tests/unit/test_identity_perf_1cc0.py tests/unit/test_identity_ts2_09f9_heldout.py tests/unit/test_verify_identity_a2c7_perf.py tests/unit/test_identity_gate_scope_and_ledger.py tests/unit/test_compact_sweep_perf.py` passes, proving `authorship.<name>` spies still observe the production call paths.
- [ ] `mypy src/rebar/attest --disallow-untyped-defs` reports no errors.
- [ ] `test "$(grep -rhE ":\s*Any\b|->\s*Any\b" src/rebar/attest/*.py | wc -l | tr -d " ")" -eq 2` exits 0, preserving the two explicit trust-root boundary annotations.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `make typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `make test` passes.
- [ ] `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 pytest -m "not integration and not external"` passes after installing the locked `dev`, `reviewbot`, and `ui` extras, matching the CI pytest selection.

## Non-overlap
Touches `src/rebar/attest/authorship.py`, the new `src/rebar/attest/authorship_resolution.py`, and focused tests only if the RED-first compatibility oracle requires one. The prerequisite abasic-doddering-harrier is merged.
